regime_context: The TSX detector shows broad, two-speed leadership concentrated in Materials/Energy (Base Metals, Oil & Gas, Gold, Silver all eligible and top-ranked) with weak breadth in most other sectors; momentum ranks are a focus lens only, and the absolute-trend gate is the one validated leg. Cross-sectional momentum itself has no forward return edge here (rank-IC ~0), so any directional lean is my own fallible judgement expressed as a falsifiable conditional — not alpha extracted from this state.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Technology (crowded=true, crowding_z 1.16, rank 8, eligible=true) confirms a leadership handoff by rising into the top 3 of ranks — the condition that would retire this watch is XIT.TO turning down and dropping below rank 10 before any top-3 print.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is rank 2, broadly eligible, and carries the highest durability_bar (0.61) in the top three — the trend-gate leg that is the one validated staying-power/risk-control signal. Its breadth (0.571) is slightly stronger than the leader's, suggesting participation is not yet thinning. This is a relative-durability lean, not a return forecast.
evidence: hurst_tag 'mixed' — less prone to the mean-revert decay seen in Base Metals/Gold
theses.dissent: Energy is a macro/geopolitics beta on TSX; with unscheduled_share at 1.0 and geopolitics the sole dominant macro theme, any headline reversal could hit the whole complex symmetrically, and Oil & Gas is only 0.11 behind the leader — no durable separation.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO gives up all of its trailing 20-day gain versus XBM.TO while Base Metals remains rank 1

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the only eligible trend-tagged theme in the top five (hurst_tag 'trend', durability_bar 0.60) that is not part of the crowded commodity complex. Its momentum rank is mid-table, but the absolute-trend gate — the one validated risk-control leg — is intact, and it offers a non-reflexive directional expression away from the two-theme commodity concentration.
evidence: not part of the Base Metals/Oil/Gold commodity cluster
theses.dissent: Breadth is only 0.286 — the theme is carried by very few names, which makes it fragile to a single-name blowup, and its score (0.70) is far below the leaders'.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO makes a lower low relative to XEG.TO over the next 30 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
